title: Neon sign
suits: nightlife, music, events, food and drink, gaming, consumer and creator apps, cyberpunk-flavoured products

params.--field: the wall by day (plum by default; any colour or gradient), shaded to night
params.--brand: the word's gas: its hue is kept, lightness and chroma lifted in OKLCH so any colour burns
params.--brand-2: the mark's gas, the same way
params.--neon-fs / --neon-weight: word size and tube thickness (long names shrink to fit 1640 px)
params.--neon-y / --neon-g: sign centre and the ground line (the reflection mirrors about it)
params.__MARK__: stroke paths in a 24 x 24 box: one bent tube

details: the unlit glass tubes come up first, with a faint highlight and a shadow on the wall
the mark strikes first, in a second gas colour, with two short flickers
letters strike roughly left to right, each with its own flicker pattern
every fresh strike comes on dim and warms to full over a quarter second
one letter stutters twice, dies, and catches late
the glow lights the wall: bricks appear only as the sign lights, strongest near it
a pool of pink light spreads on the wet ground and the kerb edge catches the glow
the sign reflects in the puddles as vertical streaks (squashed, blurred, stretched), cut by dry patches of asphalt
the tube that runs between letters is painted out, on two standoffs
a power cable leaves the last letter and droops down the wall to the ground
a fine drizzle is visible only inside the glow
at rest the tubes buzz: a faint, out-of-phase brightness flutter on the deck clock
every 17 s the same stubborn letter drops out for a double blink
a navy or black brand still burns: the gas keeps the hue and lifts it to neon lightness; a white brand burns cool white
